actual_scope: Repair (b) of PR1956: restate the PR387 / FINITE_BIT_ACCOUNTING ordinary-bootstrap cutoff lemma so the cutoff's constant is a stock/fit (space) coefficient only, prove that the stage time bound holds for all widths with the carried constant C_old*2^(L*Delta a) absorbed into the next time constant, and check the selected #1094 receipt's 14 recorded cutoffs against the restated rule.
scope_change_reason: Refined from the card's general all-size implication to one lemma (the finite bootstrap cutoff) on one certificate; chooser nonce bff97872294a70402bf5bd4940f9436f drew complex-mechanisms, overridden by donor/coordinator preference for PR1956's open question 1 (complex-mechanisms already had several sessions in this run and the rank-shape card returned 153 overlap matches).
bottleneck_link: Side result for reliability: the cutoffs are part of the selected record's finite all-size bootstrap witness; kappa does not depend on them. Under hypotheses H1-H3 read from the retained sources, the recorded cutoffs are valid exactly when each stock coefficient sigma_j <= 2^(headroom_j-3); that condition is plausible by a wide margin but not verified, so this reduces PR1956's failure to an uncomputed space obligation.
stop_rule: Stop after the restated lemma with proof, the exact fit-only check and headroom of all 14 recorded cutoffs, and controls; do not compute the actual stock coefficients sigma_j or other lineages.
evidence: README proof of the restated lemma (absorption bound sup (1+t)2^(-delta t) <= max(2, 2/(e ln2 delta)); time bound for all e>=1 with C_j = max(K(4+M), C_(j-1)2^(L Delta a)); fit k<e/2 for e>=2^L with C=8 sigma). verify.py (stdlib, exact Fractions): 14 recorded cutoffs reproduce and satisfy the fit-only rule; exact stock headroom 6,562,783 bits at stage 1 rising to ~3e23 at stage 7; certified ln2>693/1000, e>2718/1000; carried factor 2^(L Delta a) alone exceeds the stage 2-7 headroom (the lemma as written fails there, matching PR1956); explicit finite time-constant chain (27-digit log2 C_7 under 512-bit fresh constants); 7 rejected controls; RESULT.json pinned.
